verdict: Yes, with honest claims. Namhya Foods from Jammu pitched ayurvedic-enriched foods on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Buyers trust traditional ingredients like turmeric, moringa and ashwagandha, but FSSAI and AYUSH rules limit what you can claim.
angle: Herbal lattes, health mixes and functional foods based on Ayurveda appeal to buyers looking for natural wellness. Clear sourcing and lab tests build trust. Women's health, immunity and digestion are strong niches.
